subject: Evening sync: short group demo + office hours (time proposals)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@devstack.com>, Nick Ramirez <nick@greengrid.com>, Leila Khan <leila@nimbusops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@gmail.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Evening sync: short group demo + office hours (time proposals)

Hi all —

Thanks again for your time last week. A few of you asked for a short, focused group demo + open office-hours block so you can walk through specific integration questions. We thought it would be efficient to run a single 30-minute demo followed by a 30-minute open Q&A where we can hop into individual screens.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: Tue Jul 20, 5:00–6:00 PM PT
- Option B: Wed Jul 21, 6:00–7:00 PM PT
- Option C: Thu Jul 22, 4:00–5:00 PM PT

Agenda (30/30):
- 0–5 min: quick intros & desired outcomes
- 5–35 min: demo: serving runtime, routing & caching examples relevant to data-ingest workflows
- 35–60 min: open office hours (breakout as needed)

Attachments: short agenda PDF and single calendar invite (we’ll finalize after you pick a slot).

If you reply with your preferred option (A/B/C) and any must-see topics, I’ll finalize the calendar and add a bridge.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0131

From: Amy Chen <amy@devstack.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evening sync: short group demo + office hours (time proposals)

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — Option A (Tue Jul 20, 5–6 PM PT) works best for DevStack.
We’re particularly interested in the routing policies (cost vs latency) and the KV/prefix caching examples you mentioned. If you can surface any telemetry or cost delta examples for a 100–200 req/s workload, that’d be great to see.

Also, could you include dial-in and the Zoom link in the calendar invite? I’ll confirm other attendees on our side once finalized.

Best,
Amy
Senior Platform Engineer, DevStack
amy@devstack.com

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for organizing. We’d prefer Option C (Thu Jul 22, 4–5 PM PT) because that maps better to our EMEA follow-up sessions (we have internal teams in London who want to join). If Option C is firmable, we can bring our infra lead and a product manager.

Must-see: multi-tenant isolation patterns and any notes on Private (VPC) deployment timelines. Also interested in any SLA / dedicated pool sizing guidance.

Thanks,
Nick

nick@greengrid.com

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@gmail.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evening sync: short group demo + office hours (time proposals)

Thanks for the quick replies — appreciate the notes. Looks like we don’t have a single slot that works for everyone. Two options:

1) Pick the slot that gets the most cross-account attendance and run the combined session (we’ll emphasize high-level topics and then triage into account-specific breaks).
2) Run two short sessions (Tue Jul 20 & Thu Jul 22), same runbook, shorter audience, and record both.

Ben / Soojin — can you advise on capacity? If we do two sessions, can Ben host Tue (5pm PT) and I host Thu (4pm PT)? Ben, are you okay to cover the caching + telemetry examples; I can focus on routing, fallbacks, and Private notes. Soojin — can you cover post-demo follow-ups and doc assets (HV/FAQ) distribution?

I’ll tentatively hold Option A for DevStack and Option C for GreenGrid and confirm by EOD once we hear from Leila (NimbusOps).

—
Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

From: Leila Khan <leila@nimbusops.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Amy Chen <amy@devstack.com>, Nick Ramirez <nick@greengrid.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 00:45:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Evening sync: short group demo + office hours (time proposals)

Hi all —

Thanks for the options. NimbusOps can join Option A (Tue Jul 20, 5–6 PM PT). I’d prefer the single combined session (option 1) if we can keep the first 30 mins focused on high-level architecture and the second 30 for targeted breakouts — that structure works well for our team.

A few asks:
- Please add a calendar invite with Zoom and an ICS we can import into our shared calendar.
- Would be helpful to attach any short pre-reads (one-pagers) that outline Dedicated vs Private for compliance teams.

If you run two sessions, we’ll likely join the Tue session.

Best,
Leila Khan
Director, Cloud Ops, NimbusOps
leila@nimbusops.com

Great — thanks everyone for the quick coordination. Based on attendance asks we’ll run a single combined session:

Confirmed: Tue Jul 20, 5:00–6:00 PM PT (we’ll keep to the 30/30 format).

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (also added to calendar invite)
Agenda & pre-reads: attached (20270721_redwood-demo-agenda.pdf).
Calendar invite: added (redwood-group-demo.ics) — please accept when you can.
Action items for the session:
- Ben: lead caching + telemetry examples (100–200 req/s sample) — Ben to paste a short data snapshot in the chat during demo.
- Priyom: routing, fallbacks & Private deployment notes — will prepare a one-pager on Private timelines.
- Soojin: follow-up doc bundle + FAQ link (<https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C>)

If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to it.
